overview: The committee received a presentation on the Wellington Transformation Study regarding future land use and development in the Wellington neighborhood. Members also voted to enter executive session to discuss litigation strategy.

items.title: Wellington Transformation Study Presentation
items.summary: Consultants presented a long-term vision to transform the Wellington area into a mixed-use commercial center focused on 'Tuff Tech' industrial growth and improved pedestrian safety at Wellington Circle. The committee discussed fiscal impacts, property owner negotiations, and senior housing options before keeping the item in committee.

items.title: Executive Session: Litigation Strategy
items.summary: Approved entering executive session to discuss litigation strategy for the case of Turtog v. City of Medford.
